description: COMUNE PIOLTELLO SERVIZIO BIKE SHARING is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lombardia. Servizio noleggio biciclette dei comuni di Pioltello Cernusco sul Naviglio Carugate. Questo servizio è stato realizzato per agevolare gli spostamenti principalmente tra una stazione e l'altra del treno e della metropolitana. Coverage: Regione Lombardia. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lombardia. Its tags are biciclette, comune-pioltello, piste-ciclabili, trasporti. It offers 5 resource(s) in CSV, JSON, RDF, TSV, XML. The portal shows 2026-09-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
